❌ Unmanaged Local stdio Shadow MCP (npx -y) & Unvetted Extensions

2. Extension Self-Whitelisting & $1,380 Marketplace Drain (SHADOW-EXTENSION-TRUST-SPEND-68)

• Calls update_trust / write_record('trust-registry') to whitelist its own publisher
• And silently wires a $1,380 third-party AI API / SaaS marketplace subscription!
3. Why Network CASBs & Endpoint Antivirus Are Blind to Local stdio MCP

• Process binary is a signed node/python interpreter; EDR misses JSON-RPC poisoning

✅ MDM Signed Allowlist + Remote MCP Gateway + Capability Broker
